positions.title: AI Engineer Intern
description: Scoped and shipped an AI customer support agent that resolves 42% of tickets on its own for customers in 4 countries, at $0.03 per resolved ticket versus $8 of staff time, saving about $16K a year and clearing an 800+ ticket backlog

Traced most escalations to German and acronym queries, lifting auto-resolution 8 points once fixed, then built a 300-case regression eval from live conversations that caught a 6-point drop from an upstream model update within 4 hours

Engineered a RAG pipeline over 4,000 pages of bilingual docs, with query rewriting feeding hybrid vector-keyword search on Azure AI Search and a reranker fine-tuned in PyTorch on 2,000 resolved tickets that lifted recall@5 from 77% to 87%

Cut monthly budget categorization from 6+ hours to 5 minutes with a LangGraph agent that fixes vendor and accounting codes on 1,000 transactions, filtering most with rules and a cache before Claude, sending low-confidence fixes to a human

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
description: Built the recommendation engine behind the company's chair-fitting app, matching each user's body measurements to the best of 100+ office chairs through layered filtering and weighted scoring across 15 ergonomic attributes, served via FastAPI
